syllabus_topics: Parameters of the stressed and strained state of materials and criteria of determination of its critical state.
Summarizing the results from static load tests.
Methods of experimental investigation of materials mechanical properties at complex stressed state.
Material testing in conditions different from the normal ones \u2013impact loads, high and low temperatures, different media.
Radiation exposure, defects caused by it, influence on the mechanical properties of structural materials.
Cycling load test- high-cycling and low-cycling fatigue.
Accelerated methods of determination of the fatigue limit of structural materials.
Material resistance against fracture and methods of determination of its characteristics.
Deformation properties of materials methods of determination of their characteristics.
Specifics of testing precipitation hardened and eutectic composites, fibrous materials, laminates, polymers and ceramics.

assessment_methods.method: activity and participation during laboratory classes

assessment_rules: The students  activity and participation during the laboratory classes is taken into consideration for forming the final mark.
degree: Computer Aided Design in Mechanical and Instrument Engineering (Bachelor)
